_comment: Example for psbt_accept.py. fee_rate is PINNED (required) so the re-assembled skeleton is byte-identical to the one your wallet signed. Use real "txid:vout" inputs so the PSBT is importable and signable. Pass 1: run with no signed_psbt -> prints the skeleton + per-participant signing indices. Sign in your wallet, paste each result into signed_psbt, re-run for Pass 2.
